description: Commission of Elections - Number of Women Candidates to be nominated under Sec. 27F of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance specifying the number of women candidates to be nominated and women members to be returned for local authority elections. It contains electoral boundary information, candidate nomination requirements, and election procedures, which directly fits the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) dealing with electoral processes and related matters.
